partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Compact causal-module tissue mechanism
results.hypothesis: A tissue-localized causal target is more credible when it shares a compact GOA process with a second gene that causes the same disease.
results.body: R037 plus causal target -involved_in-> process[<=100 genes] <-involved_in- second causal gene -causes-> disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Adds an independently annotated, nonlinear disease module around the inhibited target, but shared process membership still does not establish whether inhibition corrects the disease mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: The target, anatomy, shared-process, and second-causal-gene motifs are TRAPI-expressible; process cardinality, exact absence, provenance, NPMI, and degree constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(other_gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object)
WHERE other_gene <> gene
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_min_anatomy_disease_degree <= 200
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Multi-driver causal-module tissue mechanism
results.hypothesis: A tissue-localized causal target is more credible when at least two other causal disease genes share one or more GOA processes with it.
results.body: R037 plus causal target shares GOA process membership with >=2 other genes that cause the disease
results.mechanism_rationale: Uses repeated causal-gene support to form a nonlinear disease module around the inhibited target, but process co-membership and causal assertions still lack corrective direction.
results.trapi_notes: The biological motifs are TRAPI-expressible; distinct-neighbor cardinality, exact absence, provenance, NPMI, and degree constraints require post-processing or Cypher.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
MATCH (gene)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)<-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(other_gene:Gene)
      -[:CAUSES]->(object)
WHERE other_gene <> gene
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND evidence._miner_min_anatomy_disease_degree <= 200
  AND subject._miner_affects_aa_decreased_gene_degree <= 50
  AND (
    evidence._miner_gene_causal_disease_degree <= 12
    OR (
      evidence._miner_causal_publication_count >= 5
      AND evidence._miner_causal_publication_npmi >= 0.5
      AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
      AND (
        evidence._miner_non_semmed_primary_source_count >= 1
        OR evidence._miner_direct_relation_type_count >= 4
      )
    )
  )
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT|CONTRAINDICATED_IN|EXACERBATES_CONDITION|CAUSES]->(object)
  }
  AND NOT EXISTS {
    MATCH (subject)-[:HAS_SIDE_EFFECT]->(:PhenotypicFeature)
          <-[:HAS_PHENOTYPE]-(object)
  }
WITH subject, object, count(DISTINCT other_gene) AS other_causal_gene_count
WHERE other_causal_gene_count >= 2
RETURN subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
